Attached: 1 image

Invoicing in Germany? From 2027/2028, B2B invoices must be e-invoices.

#ivly creates #XRechnung and #ZUGFeRD invoices, validates them against EN 16931 before sending and stores all data as GOBL, an open JSON format.

Self-hosted with Podman or Docker, on a notebook or a private server. No SaaS, no tracking. Early stage, feedback welcome.

https://ivly.de
Source (AGPL-3.0): https://codeberg.org/ivly
